# Cuba (CUB) - could not get the province figures

**Result: not found in reachable sources. Not established that they are unpublished.** No rows.csv.

## Tried
- ONEI Anuario Estadístico de Cuba 2024, ch. 19 "Salud pública y protección social" (http://www.onei.gob.cu/sites/default/files/publicaciones/2025-09/19-salud-publica-y-proteccion-social_aec2024.pdf), downloaded and read. Table 19.17 lists the main causes of death nationally 2020-2024; assault (agresiones) is not among the top ten listed. The province tables cover only maternal and infant mortality, low birth weight etc. There is no assault/homicide table. The 2025 yearbook lists no public-order/justice chapter.
- MINSAP Anuario Estadístico de Salud, which has "defunciones por agresiones" and province mortality tables: files.sld.cu, temas.sld.cu, salud.msp.gob.cu, instituciones.sld.cu/dne all reset the connection from this environment. Wayback availability data service: no snapshots for the 2020-2023 editions. A 2018 edition snapshot exists (http://web.archive.org/web/20261004203722/https://files.sld.cu/bvscuba/files/2019/04/Anuario-Electr%c3%b3nico-Espa%c3%b1ol-2018-ed-2019-compressed.pdf), but web.archive.org downloads are blocked by egress policy here.
- The web search budget was used up before alternative mirrors (PAHO, BVS, ResearchGate) could be searched.

## Next step
Fetch the MINSAP Anuario Estadístico de Salud (latest edition) from a network that can reach sld.cu, then extract the table of deaths by assault (agresiones, X85-Y09) by province.

## Retry (retry_within_a, 18 Oct 2026): still not obtained
- web search "Anuario Estadístico de Salud 2023 Cuba pdf defunciones agresiones por provincia" found the 2023 edition (https://files.sld.cu/bvscuba/files/2024/10/Anuario-Estad%c3%adstico-de-Salud-2023-EDICION-2024.pdf), the 2022 edition (https://instituciones.sld.cu/socientificas/files/2023/10/Anuario-Estadistico-de-Salud-2022.pdf) and a provincial yearbook "Anuario Gtmo 2020" (https://instituciones.gtm.sld.cu/dps/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/05/Anuario-Gtmo-2020.pdf). All are on sld.cu hosts.
- direct download: every sld.cu host still resets or is refused by the egress proxy (instituciones.gtm.sld.cu: connect_rejected). onei.gob.cu now also resets over HTTPS.
- the web reader did open the 2023 edition, but its text extraction stops at 58,213 characters (about printed page 22, Cuadro 6). The index it returned lists "Cuadro 14. Principales causas de muerte según provincia. 2022-2023" (p. 35) and "Cuadro 21. Tasas de mortalidad por tres grandes grupos de causas según sexo y provincia" (p. 53), but the table bodies are beyond the cut-off, so no figures were seen.
- archive.org availability data service: snapshot exists (http://web.archive.org/web/20250808201535/https://files.sld.cu/bvscuba/files/2024/10/Anuario-Estad%C3%ADstico-de-Salud-2023-EDICION-2024.pdf), but web.archive.org tunnels close mid-exchange here.
- Next step: download that PDF in a normal browser and extract Cuadro 14 (and any "agresiones" rows by province). The Guantánamo provincial yearbook may also give municipalities.

## Retry (retry_within_a), second route: one province found via a journal article
- web search "mortalidad por agresiones Cuba provincias tasa homicidio scielo": most hits on sld.cu (unreachable) or doaj.org (bot-check challenge), plus a Medigraphic copy of "Homicidio en la provincia de Matanzas. 1989 al 2016" (Revista Médica Electrónica 2017, https://www.medigraphic.com/pdfs/revmedele/me-2017/me173l.pdf). Downloaded and read.
- Extracted: crude homicide rate per 100 000 for the 13 municipalities of Matanzas province, 1989-2016 as one period (Gráf. 5, chart data labels, page rendered and read), and the province's 802 homicide deaths in 1989-2016 (615 male, 188 female as stated - these sum to 803).
- Not extracted: annual province rates in Gráf. 1 (labels overlap; not reliably readable). The article's methods say rates "por 10000 habitantes" but every chart caption says "Tasa cruda por 100000 habitantes"; rows follow the chart captions. The abstract gives the rate range as 1,75-7,2 while the results text says 2,26-7,14.
- This is one province only and an academic article, not an official table. The national MINSAP province table (Anuario Estadístico de Salud) is still needed for the other provinces.
